sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October (15:00) looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Despite that defeat, Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and will be heavy favorites against struggling Alsager, who sit bottom with just 4 points and have won only once all season. This is Sandbach's sole fixture in the period.
divisionWide: The title race remains competitive, with second-placed Stafford Town hosting Dawley Town on Saturday in a matchup between mid-table sides. Close behind, AFC Bridgnorth (3rd, 19 points) face Eccleshall (5th, 18 points) in a direct clash between title contenders. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, visit Wednesfield Community in what should be an intriguing local encounter. Bilston Town (6th) host Foley Meir in a battle of mid-table sides. Elsewhere, Barnton welcome Shawbury United, who sit 15th and are in alarming form with six consecutive losses. Market Drayton Town face New Mills in a contest between struggling sides—both have won just four games this season. Crewe host Allscott Heath in another mid-table affair, while Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town at the foot of the table. Widnes Town, rooted at the bottom with just 2 points, travel to Brereton Social. Finally, Brereton Social then host Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October (19:45) in a midweek clash.
